feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle are raised on grass and locally grown hay and finished on locally sourced corn and barley for 90-120 days.

local_areas: Within 15 miles of Idaho Falls ($3.00), farther at $0.25 per mile
pickup_locations: Meetups in Idaho Falls, across from Reeds Dairy on Broadway or in the Cabela's parking lot

notes: Hereford and Angus beef ranch in southeastern Idaho overlooking the Snake River Valley, calving on the desert west of Idaho Falls. The pickup page lists 10324 W Arco Hwy, Idaho Falls, ID 83402, used here for town and zip only. Checked the homepage, about page and pickup page. Cattle graze meadow grass in summer and fall and eat alfalfa hay in winter, then are finished on locally sourced corn and barley for 90 to 120 days, so the listing is grain-finished. The site says no hormone implants, ionophores or antibiotics. Delivery is $3.00 within 15 miles of Idaho Falls and $0.25 per mile beyond; shipping is only considered case by case. The homepage asks whether buyers would want quarters, halves or wholes but does not offer them, so bulk_shares is false. No phone or social links on the site.
